function.name: DRAW_BOX
function.param: Horizontal coordinate of the first point
Horizontal coordinate of the second point
Vertical coordinate of the second point

description.p: It draws a filled rectangle between two spots, using the selected colour with , in the chosen graph by the last call to . All delimited points by these four coordinates will be changed to chosen colour. It is valid to specify coordinates out of the limits of the graph, but the picture will cut off over these.
